headline: Toyota Hikes Full-Year Profit Forecasts on Strong Hybrid Demand
summary: Japanese automaker Toyota raised its full-year profit forecasts, driven by strong demand for hybrid vehicles and a weak yen, despite fierce competition from Chinese rivals.
why: Toyota Motor Corporation is one of the world's largest automotive manufacturers, providing a key bellwether for the global auto industry.

impacts.name: Toyota Motor Corp
impacts.why: Raising full-year profit forecasts directly signals stronger anticipated financial performance for the company.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The upward revision in profit forecasts reflects robust demand for hybrid vehicles and currency tailwinds from a weak yen.
